name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-installer
description: Epic P1-04's isolated-install security core: stage an untrusted plugin tarball in a read-only quarantine, extract it without running any lifecycle script, and REFUSE (not silently strip) a path-traversal, absolute-path, symlink or hardlink entry or an over-ratio decompression, so a malicious package never reaches the profile; signature/SBOM provenance stays the existing P1-02 path
